records.claim: It is not known if carbamazepine can increase the chance of behavior or learning issues for the child. Some studies have found a small increased chance for speech delay or lower IQ scores in children who also have minor facial defects after exposure to carbamazepine during pregnancy. Other studies have found no differences in child development or intelligence.
records.source_section: Does taking carbamazepine in pregnancy affect future behavior or learning for the child?
